useCases: Blog index or news listing page when the tenant has the blog feature enabled.
Paginated grid of posts with thumbnails and read-time metadata.
avoidWhen: Single static article content — use a custom page or rich blocks instead.

useCases: Nested page hierarchies (e.g. /services/consulting) where users need parent context.
Placed near the top of content pages below the navbar.
avoidWhen: Flat single-level sites with only the homepage and one contact page.

useCases: Rotating image galleries, testimonial strips, or card highlights on marketing pages.
When you need arrows, indicators, or autoplay across multiple slides.
avoidWhen: A single static image or quote — use a simpler content block instead.

useCases: Portfolio or success-stories index linking to individual case study pages.
Grid of client work with cover image, industry, and summary.

useCases: Full case study article: challenge, solution, tech stack, impact metrics.
Dedicated slug page under /case-studies/ or similar.
avoidWhen: Listing multiple projects — use caseStudiesBlock.

useCases: All-in-one contact page with info cards plus embedded messaging form.

avoidWhen: Split layout with sidebar info and main form only — use contactInfoBlock or contactFormSection.

useCases: Standalone lead-capture form section (name, email, message).
Full-width form without adjacent address/phone cards.
avoidWhen: Form already inside contactInfoBlock — do not duplicate on the same page.

useCases: Contact page with form plus email, phone, and address in a side column.
Company profile fallbacks merge into empty contact fields at build time.
avoidWhen: Map-first location page — use location block; form-only — use contactFormSection.

useCases: Mid-page or bottom-of-page conversion push with headline and single CTA.
Between content sections on homepage or pricing adjacent pages.
avoidWhen: Primary above-the-fold hero — use hero or heroBlock.

useCases: Visual separation between two block regions on the same page.
Light structural break without extra content.
Accordion FAQ on contact, pricing, or booking pages.
Answering objections before reservation or contact submission.
avoidWhen: FAQ is part of a full pricing layout — pricingPageBlock includes its own FAQ region.

useCases: Product or platform benefits in a scannable multi-column grid.
Homepage or landing sections with icon/title/description items.
avoidWhen: Bookable service menu with prices — use services or servicesPageBlock.

useCases: Site-wide footer with link columns and copyright on every page.

Simple centered hero: title, optional subtitle, one CTA.
Inner pages (menu, about subpages) that need a compact banner.

Portfolio or SaaS-style above-the-fold landing sections.
avoidWhen: Minimal single-CTA banner — use hero.

useCases: Address, hours, and optional embedded map for visit-us pages.
Build merges company profile address when block fields are empty.
avoidWhen: No physical location or map — use contactInfoBlock only.

useCases: Trusted-by logo rows, press mentions, or partner strips.

About page vision or mission statement with optional supporting image.
Single narrative column focused on why the business exists.

First block on most pages or provided via client header config.

avoidWhen: Long-form services marketing page — use servicesPageBlock.

useCases: Full services marketing page: hero, feature categories, service cards, FAQ.
Dense deliverables and pricing descriptors per offering.
avoidWhen: Compact homepage teaser grid — use services.

Social proof before a CTA or pricing section.
avoidWhen: Full testimonials directory page — use testimonialsPageBlock.

SEO-focused social proof hub.
avoidWhen: Short quote strip on homepage — use testimonialsBlock.
